ai_summary: Dhabriya Polywood Ltd. has secured a significant domestic work order valued at ₹11.79 Crore (including GST) from Conscient Group for the supply and installation of uPVC doors and windows. This contract, scheduled for completion over 24 months, represents a material addition to the company's order book, positively impacting its future revenue streams and operational pipeline. No red flags are apparent, as the disclosure indicates this is a standard business transaction with no related party involvement.
